<problem>
A set $S\subset\mathbb N$ is a Sidon set if all sums $a+b$ with $a,b\in S$, $a\le b$, are distinct. Let $h(N)$ be the maximum size of a Sidon set contained in $\{1,\dots,N\}$. Is it true that, for every $\varepsilon>0$, $h(N)=N^{1/2}+O_\varepsilon(N^{\varepsilon})$?
</problem>

</finite_instance>

<solution>
This is a well-known open problem of Erdős (\$500 prize); it is neither proved nor disproved, and I cannot resolve it. What is known:

Setup: $S\subset\{1,\dots,N\}$ Sidon, $|S|=k$; equivalently all nonzero differences $a-b$ ($a\ne b\in S$) are distinct.

1. Upper bound $h(N)\le N^{1/2}+N^{1/4}+1$ (Erdős–Turán/Lindström). Fix $u\ge1$, let $I_j=\{j,\dots,j+u-1\}$, $j=2-u,\dots,N$ ($N+u-1$ intervals, each point of $[1,N]$ in exactly $u$ of them), $A_j=|S\cap I_j|$. Then $\sum A_j=ku$, and $\sum\binom{A_j}{2}$ counts pairs $a<b$ in $S$ with weight $\max(u-(b-a),0)$; since each difference $d\in[1,u-1]$ occurs at most once, $\sum\binom{A_j}2\le\sum_{d=1}^{u-1}(u-d)=u(u-1)/2$. Cauchy–Schwarz gives $\sum A_j^2\ge (ku)^2/(N+u-1)$, so $k^2\le (N+u-1)(k+u-1)/u<(N/u+1)(k+u)$. With $u=\lceil N^{3/4}\rceil$: $k^2-(N^{1/4}+1)k-(N+N^{3/4})\le0$, hence $k\le \frac{N^{1/4}+1+\sqrt{(N^{1/4}+1)^2+4N+4N^{3/4}}}{2}\le N^{1/2}+N^{1/4}+1$, using $(2N^{1/2}+N^{1/4}+1)^2\ge (N^{1/4}+1)^2+4N+4N^{3/4}$. Refinements: $N^{1/2}+N^{1/4}+1/2$ (Lindström), $N^{1/2}+0.998N^{1/4}$ (Balogh–Füredi–Roy 2023), with later small constant improvements; nothing beats exponent $1/4$.

2. Lower bound $h(N)\ge N^{1/2}-O(N^{0.2625+o(1)})$. Singer: for prime power $q$ there is a perfect difference set of $q+1$ residues mod $q^2+q+1$, giving a Sidon set, so $h(q^2+q+1)\ge q+1$. Taking the largest prime $p$ with $p^2+p+1\le N$ and the Baker–Harman–Pintz gap bound $p_{n+1}-p_n\le p_n^{0.525}$ yields the stated bound. (Even RH only gives error $N^{1/4+o(1)}$ this way.)

3. Conclusion: $N^{1/2}-N^{0.2625+o(1)}\le h(N)\le N^{1/2}+0.998N^{1/4}$, and whether the error can be $O_\varepsilon(N^\varepsilon)$ is open. Erdős believed $h(N)=N^{1/2}+O(1)$ is false, but no construction with $|S|\ge N^{1/2}+c$ for arbitrarily large $c$ is known either. No yes/no answer can currently be given.
</solution>
